summary: community.docker docker_image and docker_image_export archive idempotency doesn't work with Docker 29's new storage backend, whose image IDs don't match manifest.json.
questions: Why is docker_image archive not idempotent on Docker 29?

answer_card.title: docker_image archive idempotency on Docker 29
answer_card.answer_md: `docker_image` and `docker_image_export` decide idempotency by comparing storage backend image IDs to those in the tarball's `manifest.json`. Docker 29's new default backend uses IDs that don't match, so archiving is **no longer idempotent**.
